title: Mohanlal Live in Australia 2026
tagline: The Complete Actor. One unforgettable night.
description: For the first time on Australian soil, the legend of Malayalam cinema takes the stage. An evening of cinema, conversation and celebration with Padma Bhushan Mohanlal - a once-in-a-generation event for the South Indian community in Australia. Produced end-to-end by Kayal Events with full concert-grade staging, sound and lighting.

shows.venue: Norwest Convention Centre, 1-5 Solent Cct, Norwest NSW 2153, Australia

ageRestriction: All ages. Under 15s must be accompanied by an adult.
entryConditions: Tickets are non-refundable except as required by Australian Consumer Law.
Professional cameras and recording equipment are not permitted.
termsAndConditions:
Children under 4 years of age are eligible for free entry. Provided the child should sit in the parent’s lap.

Seating will be arranged according to the seat number selected at the time of booking.

No food or drinks are allowed inside the hall. Please consume all food and beverages in the designated areas outside the hall

Tickets can be scanned on a mobile device, provided the screen is clearly visible and undamaged.

If mobile scanning is unsuccessful, a printed ticket confirmation is required.

All ticket sales are final. No refunds, exchanges, or cancellations will be processed once tickets are confirmed.

In the event of cancellation or postponement, only the face value of the ticket will be refunded.

Booking fees are non-refundable. A booking fee per ticket may apply.

Customers must check the total payable amount before completing the transaction.

The Event Organizer reserves the right to remove individuals from the venue for any form of misconduct or misbehavior. No refund will be provided in such cases.

The Event Organizer and its agents are not liable for any injuries, damages, theft, losses, or costs incurred during the event.

The Event Organizer is not responsible for lost or stolen personal belongings.

By attending the event, you consent to the recording and use of your image, voice, and likeness for advertising, publicity, and promotional purposes, in any media, worldwide and indefinitely, without compensation.

To enhance the experience for all attendees and avoid distracting the performers, we kindly request that parents ensure children are well supervised throughout the event.

Terms and conditions are subject to change at the discretion of the Event Organizer without prior notice.

Video recording inside the venue is strictly prohibited during the event. Patrons are requested not to record any part of the show. Unauthorized recording may lead to removal from the venue without prior notice.

faqs.question: Will there be a meet and greet?
faqs.answer: A limited Platinum meet-and-greet allocation is available per city. Details are included with Platinum tickets.

faqs.question: Is parking available at the venue?
faqs.answer: Both venues offer on-site and nearby paid parking. We recommend public transport on event night.

faqs.question: What languages is the show in?
faqs.answer: The evening is presented primarily in Malayalam with English where appropriate.
